llm.corsHint: This app routes requests through the same-origin /api-proxy (the Vite middleware in dev, docker/nginx.conf in production). llm.emptyHint: This is usually a blocked cross-origin request, a Base URL that does not end in /v1, or a model ID that does not support streaming. Try testing the provider connection first.

llm.timeout: The request timed out or was cancelled
